records.scope: Keep all existing baseline files, module APIs, and active engineering ownership authoritative; M0-M4 introduce no replacement baseline.
records.risk: A future migration could become irreversible if a candidate is promoted by overwriting the active baseline instead of using admission and versioning.

records.scope: Remove or supersede only candidate mappings, aliases, and planning references before activation; active Runtime and contracts remain untouched.
records.risk: Rollback would be harder if a later phase activates a candidate without recording its admission version and reverse mapping.

records.scope: Retain prior architecture and planning assets as historical evidence while changing only canonical status in a separately authorized freeze or migration phase.
records.risk: Deleting or rewriting historical documents would remove provenance needed to distinguish legacy intent from current authority.

records.scope: Use M2 source-owner precedence and single-writer records to reject or reverse any future owner transfer that lacks explicit admission.
records.risk: A future metadata update without a recorded previous owner could create an ambiguous writer during rollback.

records.scope: Keep the root A3 Runtime as the existing engineering surface; future cognitive Runtime and adapter candidates can be withheld without modifying it.
records.risk: Directly embedding cognitive ownership into the legacy Runtime would couple rollback to active execution behavior.

records.scope: All M3 adapters remain FUTURE_CANDIDATE with implementation_created=false, so the safe rollback is to leave them unimplemented or withdraw their candidate references.
records.risk: An adapter implemented without an admission version, feature gate, and reverse path could create an untracked second mainline.

records.rollback_item: Retain Field State and Reality precedence
records.scope: Preserve Field State Reducer and Field State Read Model as the governed world-state path; cognitive projections remain non-factual candidates.
records.risk: A future bypass could contaminate current Reality and make state restoration non-deterministic.

records.scope: M0-M4 perform planning and validation only; migration_executed remains false, so no active engineering state needs restoration in this phase.
records.risk: Treating this review as proof of an executed migration would produce a false rollback record.
